'''Niranjan Parajuli''' (Nepali: निरञ्जन पराजुली) is a Nepali chemist, [[biochemist]], and [[biotechnologist]]. He served as president of the Nepal Chemical Society from 2019 to 2021, and was a professor of chemistry at Tribhuvan University.<ref>Keinan, E. The 18th Asian Chemical Congress and the 20th General Assembly of the Federation of Asian Chemical Societies (FACS): December 8–12, 2019, Taipei International Convention Center, Taiwan. Israel Journal of Chemistry 2020, 60 (8–9), 907–934. https://doi.org/10.1002/ijch.202000075.</ref><ref>तरकारीमा विषादी परीक्षणको नतिजा नै अविश्वसनीय. BBC News नेपाली. https://www.bbc.com/nepali/news-49113217 (accessed 2025-12-16).</ref> From March 2025 to March 2026, he worked as a research scientist at North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University, USA. His research focuses on microbial biotechnology,<ref>Je, W. P.; Hong, J. S. J.; Parajuli, N.; Won, S. J.; Sung, R. P.; Lim, S.-K.; Jae, K. S.; Yeo, J. Y. Genetic Dissection of the Biosynthetic Route to Gentamicin A<inf>2</Inf> by Heterologous Expression of Its Minimal Gene Set. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America 2008, 105 (24), 8399–8404.</ref> natural products,<ref>Joshi, S.; Huo, C.; Budhathoki, R.; Gurung, A.; Bhattarai, S.; Sharma, K. == Research ==
Parajuli’s research focuses on microbial biotechnology<ref>Je, W. P.; Hong, J. S. J.; Parajuli, N.; Won, S. J.; Sung, R. P.; Lim, S.-K.; Jae, K. S.; Yeo, J. Y. Genetic Dissection of the Biosynthetic Route to Gentamicin A<inf>2</Inf> by Heterologous Expression of Its Minimal Gene Set. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America 2008, 105 (24), 8399–8404.</ref>, natural product discovery<ref>Budhathoki, R.; Timilsina, A. P.; Regmi, B. P.; Sharma, K. R.; Aryal, N.; Parajuli, N. Metabolome Mining of Curcuma Longa L. Using HPLC-MS/MS and Molecular Networking. Metabolites 2023, 13 (8), 898. https://doi.org/10.3390/metabo13080898.</ref>, protein engineering<ref>Parajuli, N.; Williams, G. J. A High-Throughput Screen for Directed Evolution of Aminocoumarin Amide Synthetases. Analytical Biochemistry 2011, 419 (1), 61–66. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ab.2011.07.037.</ref>, and computational chemistry<ref>Upadhyaya, S. R.; Bashyal, J.; Raut, B. K.; Parajuli, N. In Silico Study of Therapeutic Potential of Natural Polyphenol Derivatives Targeting Pancreatic Lipase. Discover Chemistry 2025, 2 (1). https://doi.org/10.1007/s44371-025-00266-0.</ref><ref>Raut, B. K.; Upadhyaya, S. R.; Bashyal, J.; Parajuli, N. In Silico and In Vitro Analyses to Repurpose Quercetin as a Human Pancreatic α-Amylase Inhibitor. ACS Omega 2023, 8 (46), 43617–43631. https://doi.org/10.1021/acsomega.3c05082.</ref><ref>Shrestha, A.; Upadhyaya, S. R.; Raut, B. K.; Bhattarai, S.; Sharma, K. R.; Parajuli, N.; Sohng, J. K.; Regmi, B. P. In Silico and In Vitro Analyses of Multiple Terpenes Predict Cryptotanshinone as a Potent Inhibitor of the Omicron Variant of SARS-CoV-2. Processes 2024, 12 (1), 230. https://doi.org/10.3390/pr12010230.</ref>. His work includes genome mining<ref>Poudel, P. B.; Dhakal, D.; Magar, R. T.; Parajuli, N.; Sohng, J. K. Genome Mining and Genetic Manipulation Reveal New Isofuranonaphthoquinones in Nocardia Species. International Journal of Molecular Sciences 2024, 25 (16), 8847. https://doi.org/10.3390/ijms25168847.</ref><ref>Bridget, A. F.; Budhathoki, R.; Huo, C.; Joshi, S.; Parajuli, N.; Sohng, J. K.; Kim, K. H. Activation of Cryptic Biosynthetic Pathways in Saccharopolyspora Spinosa through Deletion of the Spinosyn Gene Cluster: Induction of Cryptic and Bioactive Natural Products. Archives of Pharmacal Research 2025, 48 (6), 514–527. https://doi.org/10.1007/s12272-025-01553-1.</ref>, [[metabolomics]]<ref>Joshi, S.; Huo, C.; Budhathoki, R.; Gurung, A.; Bhattarai, S.; Sharma, K. R.; Kim, K. H.; Parajuli, N. HPLC-ESI-HRMS/MS-Based Metabolite Profiling and Bioactivity Assessment of Catharanthus Roseus. Plants 2025, 14 (15), 2395. https://doi.org/10.3390/plants14152395.</ref> and in silico studies of bioactive compounds<ref>Upadhyaya, S. R.; Bashyal, J.; Raut, B. K.; Parajuli, N. In Silico Study of Therapeutic Potential of Natural Polyphenol Derivatives Targeting Pancreatic Lipase. Discover Chemistry 2025, 2 (1). https://doi.org/10.1007/s44371-025-00266-0.</ref><ref>Raut, B. K.; Upadhyaya, S. R.; Bashyal, J.; Parajuli, N. In Silico and In Vitro Analyses to Repurpose Quercetin as a Human Pancreatic α-Amylase Inhibitor. ACS Omega 2023, 8 (46), 43617–43631. https://doi.org/10.1021/acsomega.3c05082.</ref><ref>Shrestha, A.; Upadhyaya, S. R.; Raut, B. K.; Bhattarai, S.; Sharma, K. R.; Parajuli, N.; Sohng, J. K.; Regmi, B. P. In Silico and In Vitro Analyses of Multiple Terpenes Predict Cryptotanshinone as a Potent Inhibitor of the Omicron Variant of SARS-CoV-2. Processes 2024, 12 (1), 230. https://doi.org/10.3390/pr12010230.</ref>. He has published studies on antibiotic biosynthesis, secondary metabolites from plants and microorganisms, and therapeutic compound modeling.
== Awards and recognition ==
* Mahendra Vidya Bhushan A and B, Government of Nepal
* Science & Technology Youth Award, Nepal Academy of Science and Technology
* Brain Pool Fellowship, National Research Foundation of Korea
* Distinguished Professor Award, Biotechnology Society of Nepal<ref>नेपाली वैज्ञानिक प्रा. डा. निरन्जन पराजुली ‘Distinguished Professor Award’ बाट सम्मानित. https://bigyankhabar.com/. https://bigyankhabar.com/news/686 (accessed 2025-11-25).</ref>
* Listed among the world's top 2% of scientists in 2025 by Stanford University–Elsevier<ref>31 Nepali scientists included in the global ranking of best scientists. GorakhaPatra. https://risingnepaldaily.com/news/71025 (accessed 2025-11-25).</ref>
== Personal life ==
Parajuli is married to journalist Madhabi Bhatta and has two sons.
